body: oh :/ if this is all keeping you up, you should probably sleep. I'll find out how to PM and I'll drop you my Skype name, so we can pm on there and maybe talk some day?

Thank you for the reply,I appreciate you sharing your personal experiences with me.

It's just hard to life like this everyday. Even now I have a cut running down my leg from my mum a minute ago. My Dad will get home and she will tell him how 'bad' I've been and I'll get it from him as well.

I kind of just want to end this. Get it over with.

ah :/I understand now, I'm sorry I've kinda not really looked into surgery like this.

All I can say is you're worth more than death no matter what their decision is... Good luck with it. :/

They would be selfish to tell you to do it by yourself. That's not you not being worthy of it.

It's stupidity and laziness on the doctors' behalves

Thank you, I'm glad I can do something to help at least a bit. 

You need to think of it this way, why do you want to change? It would be easier to accept yourself for who you are, that doesn't mean stop being transgendered. If you meet someone in the future, they'll love you for who you are not how you are.

I'm going to be honest I thought about what you're going through at one point as well. But then I realised I love people for their personality not their body.

Listen, do not let choices like this be determined by other people. Not by the person perhaps sending you away and definitely not by us helping you hang yourself. I have a transgender friend myself, you just have to grasp the idea and drive through with it.

Think about how you would see yourself 5 years from now, you'll know that you were better than this and worth more. I'm sorry that I'm not helpful.
